s: flatmate, cohabitor (person living in the same house, room, apartment etc. as oneself)
to bring (something, especially as a gift)
Ich habe eine Flasche Wein mitgebracht.
I brought a bottle of wine.
to continue to have (during a transition)
Er bringt die richtigen Qualifikationen für die neue Aufgabe mit.
He has the right qualifications for the new job.
Die neue Partnerin bringt einige gute Kunden mit in die Firma.
The new partner brings some good clients with her to the firm.
mitbringen.et: mit- + bringen; cognate with Hunsrik mitbringe.

s: a small present brought by a guest or someone returning from a journey
to get or be given something when leaving
to notice, learn, find out (become aware, become informed, come to know)
I didn't hear anything about it.
a brother in the faith, especially a fellow member of the Catholic clergy or a fellow monk
a fellow human being; male in the singular, also generic in the plural
Mitbruder.et: mit (“with, co-”) + Bruder (“brother”), a calque of Latin confrater.
